title: Ordinary vector-integration compact support and adjunction coordinates
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian and $\pi:V\to S$ a constant-rank-$d$ vector bundle with zero section [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. For a finite commutative coefficient ring $A$, work on ordinary-etale derived module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Define $c_\pi$ to be the canonical Nagata compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] used in the already constructed integration [def-amb-vector-integration]. Define $F_\pi$ to be the ordinary compact-support functor computed with $c_\pi$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], and take its actual Brown adjunction with the ordinary exceptional functor [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. For $N\in\mathbf N$ with $NA=0$, put $W=\pi^*L_S(d)[2d]$ using the actual ordered coefficient of integration, and define the twisted pullback at $K$ as $L\pi^*K\otimes_A^LW$ [def-kun-derived-tensor] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Define its coefficient-first projection $K\otimes_A^LF_\pi W\to F_\pi(L\pi^*K\otimes_A^LW)$ by the actual compactified projection arrow [def-kun-projection-formula-map], conjugated by the canonical signed symmetries [lem-kun-tensor-sym]. These are specified coordinates, with no purity or invertibility assertion.

source.place: Displayed integration adjunct: the ordinary compact-support functor, its adjunction, twisted pullback and coefficient-first projection used before taking the adjunct. The Nagata model is the published coordinate model of the same integration.
